review:
Aztec Bonanza is one of Pragmatic Play's earlier variable-ways games. It plays on a 5x6 layout with up to 7,776 ways to win, and tumbling wins replace winning symbols with new ones that can form further combinations. Mystery symbols and giant symbols add variety, sometimes covering several positions at once.

The free spins round adds a random feature on every spin, which can change how the reels behave from one spin to the next. Pragmatic Play's in-game screen advertises wins of up to 19,000x, a much higher ceiling than most of the studio's titles from that period. The 96.53% RTP is also strong. If you enjoy unpredictable bonus rounds rather than one repeated mechanic, it's worth exploring in demo.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
